content.short: Hyperithm is a global digital asset manager running market-neutral strategies and curating vaults.
content.description: Hyperithm manages digital assets for institutional clients with systematic, market-neutral strategies, and curates on-chain vaults on Hyperliquid and Monad. Traditional asset managers moving on-chain as curators is a relatively recent development, and it changes the question a depositor faces from which protocol to trust to which manager's judgement to back.
